value: Deterministic autoencoder: MLP encoder to a basal latent state; additive composition with learned perturbation embeddings (scaled by per-perturbation dose/time MLP f_j with f_j(0)=0) and covariate embeddings; MLP decoder outputs Gaussian mean and variance; adversarial MLP discriminators on the basal state. chemCPA extension replaces the perturbation dictionary with an RDKit-fingerprint-based perturbation network.

value: Supervised/conditional autoencoding: Gaussian negative log-likelihood reconstruction plus adversarial cross-entropy (with gradient penalty) to remove perturbation and covariate information from the basal state. Requires perturbation, dose and covariate labels.
